Grace is going to travel to Sydney in December. It takes twenty minutes to get to the pedestrian street by bike. Grace hopes to visit Sydney one day. For example, the fishermen caught a huge squid off the coast.
They took many photos at the subway station. Grace and Eva had great fun there. Grace thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. They filmed the classic comedies at a studio in Ealing.
Grace wrote about the day in the diary. Grace drinks water after doing sports. The pedestrian street is one of the best places in the city. In fact, she sliced the bread and made sandwiches.
Grace usually has noodles for breakfast. Life is full of small surprises. Eva is interested in reading.
